name: Kurihara Yume
source: A girl that [url=/c21738]Riku[/url] encountered on the streets, has an otaku atmosphere. Likes anime, manga and games, she also likes to secretly buy hentai doujins. A very shy girl, often cowers in front of people. But if she chatted about her favorite topics, then it becomes endless. Although she is a bit afraid of the protagonist, she tries very hard to talk to him. She seems to have an impression on the protagonist's clock.
